lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Under the glow of the velvet night,
He stepped into the spotlight's golden light.
With a silver cane and a polished grin,
He let the magic of the music begin.
[Pre-Chorus]
The brass began to bloom and sway,
Chasing the shadows of the day.
[Chorus]
Midnight is dancing on the ballroom floor,
Opening a grand and secret door.
Every note is a velvet kiss,
In a world of rhythm and bliss.
[Verse]
He traded his secrets for a soulful tune,
Beneath the silver sliver of a crescent moon.
The stars were leaning in to hear him speak,
Giving the pulse of the city a peak.
[Pre-Chorus]
The rhythm caught a steady stride,
With nowhere for the melody to hide.
[Chorus]
Midnight is dancing on the ballroom floor,
Opening a grand and secret door.
Every note is a velvet kiss,
In a world of rhythm and bliss.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
One final spark of a copper flame,
Changing the rules of the musical game.
[Chorus]
Midnight is dancing on the ballroom floor,
Opening a grand and secret door.
Every note is a velvet kiss,
In a world of rhythm and bliss.
[Outro]
